incident_text: A big fire is burning on this street tonight.

result.scene_summary: A quiet, dark street at night with a row of illuminated brick buildings featuring windows, doors, and hanging flower boxes.

observations.description: A row of multi-story brick buildings with white-framed windows and doors.
Street lamps mounted on the buildings, emitting light.
Hanging flower boxes with red flowers on the building facades.
Dark street with no visible pedestrians or vehicles.
A dark, narrow alleyway extending into the distance.
